outlet.name: ABC News (US)
outlet.summary: ABC News in the United States, the network's national and world file is leading with Lindsay Clancy trial: Tensions flare as defense blames 1 juror for deadlock; LIVE: ABC News Live; Trump administration files urgent appeal with Supreme Court over mail-in ballot rules.

items.headline: Lindsay Clancy trial: Tensions flare as defense blames 1 juror for deadlock
items.detail: The trial of Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mom who killed her three young children in January 2023, has reached its final stages.

items.headline: LIVE: ABC News Live
items.detail: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

items.headline: Trump administration files urgent appeal with Supreme Court over mail-in ballot rules
items.detail: The Trump administration filed an urgent appeal with the U.S. Supreme Court seeking permission to immediately implement new U.S. Postal Service rules for mail ballots.

items.headline: Excavation work to build Trump's arch to begin over next 2 weeks: Interior secretary
items.detail: Excavation work for the construction of President Donald Trump's "triumphal arch" will begin over the next two weeks, Interior Secretary Doug Burgum announced.

items.headline: WATCH: 1st look at Billie Jean King documentary
items.detail: The ESPN 30 for 30 documentary “Give Me the Ball!,” takes a look at the personal story behind King's high-profile battles and premieres Nov. 22 on ESPN.
